subject: Hosted API throughput accelerator onboarding & graceband amendment
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@quicklist.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API throughput accelerator — onboarding plan + graceband

Samir — great to see the usage spike during your pilot. Quick recap and request:

- QuickList hit sustained spikes (90% of peak) for 3x the 30-day average; your engineering team expects Q4 traffic to continue that trajectory.
- Based on the pattern, we recommend upgrading your monthly committed throughput from 2M tokens to 6M tokens and enabling a temporary graceband (30% burst) for the first 90 days while you finish rollout.

Next steps we propose:
1) Sign a short amendment for the uplift (term: add-on to current annual agreement).
2) Add a 90-day graceband that allows bursts up to 30% beyond committed throughput with soft-throttle behavior.
3) Joint onboarding call to confirm rate-limit windows and caching config — propose Thu 10/22 10am PT.

I've looped in Karthik and Ben for pricing and ops. I'll draft the amendment and MAP once we confirm timing.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx)

From: Samir Shah <samir@quicklist.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@quicklist.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API throughput accelerator — onboarding plan + graceband

Vanessa — thanks for the clear proposal. Alyssa and I reviewed usage patterns and agree the uplift is necessary. Couple clarifying points:

- Is the 30% graceband billed as overage or absorbed into committed usage for the 90-day window?
- Can we phase the rate-limit increase so we start with a 4M commit for month 1 and move to 6M in month 2 if metrics look good?

Also, please share the amendment draft. Thu 10/22 at 10am PT works for us.

— Samir
Head of Platform
QuickList

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:14 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samir — great to see the usage spike during your pilot...

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@quicklist.com>, Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@quicklist.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API throughput accelerator — onboarding plan + graceband

Thanks for confirming the slot and the questions — notes from our call below. (Keeping it brief; attached MAP + initial amendment draft.)

Call highlights:
- Phased ramp: QuickList to move to a two-step commit: 4M tokens for November (prorated) -> 6M tokens from December onward.
- Graceband: 90-day graceband will be enabled immediately, configured as a soft-throttle (requests within graceband receive reduced priority but are not hard-rejected).
- Billing: Graceband usage during the 90-day window will be billed as overage at a reduced overage rate (0.5x standard overage) unless total monthly usage permanently exceeds the committed level after the 90 days; at that point, we'll propose adjusting the commit in the renewal.
- Ops alignment: Karthik will own deployment of rate windows; Ben will own billing/proration & invoicing mechanics.

Action items:
- Vanessa: finalize amendment draft & MAP, circulate for internal legal review (ETA: 10/26).
- Karthik: confirm rate-window config for soft-throttle and provide runbook (ETA: 10/28).
- Ben: provide invoice proration example for a Nov 1 partial month uplift (ETA: 10/27).
- Samir/Alyssa: review amendment + MAP and send redlines by 10/30.

Attachments included: QuickList_Hosted_Uplift_Amendment_v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Vanessa

> On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 8:03 AM Samir Shah <samir@quicklist.com> wrote:
> > Vanessa — thanks for the clear proposal...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@quicklist.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final amendment & invoice example for Nov proration

Samir / Alyssa — attaching the signed amendment (QuickList_Hosted_Uplift_Amendment_v1.pdf) and a short invoice example that shows the prorated Nov charge for the 4M commit + projected additional overage at the 0.5x reduced rate for graceband usage.

Key commercial summary (plain language):
- Nov (partial month): prorated charge for 4M commit (effective 11/01) + any overage at 0.5x rate for graceband usage.
- Dec onward: monthly committed throughput = 6M tokens; standard per-token unit pricing applies to tokens within commit.
- 90-day graceband window active through 01/29/2027.

Samir — please reply with confirmation that the amendment looks good and whether you want us to send DocuSign to the same signer on your side.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: QuickList_Hosted_Uplift_Amendment_v1.pdf)
